#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll INF = 1000000000LL;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap, flow, cost;
};

struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n) : n(n), g(n) {}

    void add_edge(int u, int v, ll cap, ll cost) {
        Edge a{v, (int)g[v].size(), cap, 0, cost};
        Edge b{u, (int)g[u].size(), 0, 0, -cost};
        g[u].push_back(a);
        g[v].push_back(b);
    }

    pair<ll, ll> min_cost_flow(int s, int t) {
        ll flow = 0;
        ll total_cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0), dist(n), curflow(n);
        vector<int> prev_node(n), prev_edge(n);

        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            curflow[s] = INF;

            priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});

            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, u] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (d != dist[u]) continue;

                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = g[u][i];
                    if (e.cap <= e.flow) continue;

                    int v = e.to;
                    ll nd = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];

                    if (dist[v] > nd) {
                        dist[v] = nd;
                        prev_node[v] = u;
                        prev_edge[v] = i;
                        curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                        pq.push({nd, v});
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) potential[i] += dist[i];

            ll add = min(curflow[t], INF - flow);
            flow += add;

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prev_node[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prev_node[v]][prev_edge[v]];
                e.flow += add;
                g[v][e.rev].flow -= add;
                total_cost += add * e.cost;
            }
        }

        return {flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    const int T = 500;
    int N = n * T;

    MinCostMaxFlow mcf(N + 2);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j) {
            mcf.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, INF, c);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i) {
        mcf.add_edge(i, N + 1, INF, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        mcf.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        --x;
        --y;

        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j) {
            int cur = 1;
            for (int r = 0; r < k; ++r) {
                mcf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                mcf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                cur += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    auto ans = mcf.min_cost_flow(N, N + 1);
    assert(ans.first == k);
    cout << ans.second << '\n';

    return 0;
}

    int n;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;

    void add_edge(int u, int v, ll cap, ll cost) {
        int id = (int)edges.size();
        edges.push_back({v, id + 1, cap, 0, cost});
        edges.push_back({u, id, 0, 0, -cost});

        adj[v].push_back(id + 1);
